title: RWM_state_series glTF Document Extension
description: Custom gltfworld vendor extension carrying per-frame world state (linear/angular velocity, actions, pose variance) that rides alongside a standard glTF STEP pose animation, sharing its time accessor.

timesAccessor.description: Index of the shared time accessor (float32 seconds, SCALAR), the same accessor used as the animation sampler input.

channel.description: One time-series channel: a (count == len(times)) accessor of up to 4 feature dims, tied to a node or the whole episode.

target.description: The node this channel applies to, or "world" for episode-wide channels (e.g. actions).

accessor.description: Index of the accessor holding this channel's data (SCALAR/VEC2/VEC3/VEC4, float32, count == len(times)).

component.description: 0-based chunk index, present only when a value's natural feature width exceeds 4 and had to be split across multiple accessors/channels of the same kind (e.g. 7-wide pose_variance, or actions with more than 4 dims). Decode concatenates chunks in ascending component order.
